_comment: hk_root_descriptor_table of Mesa 25.2.x (offsetof() on the built driver, 25.2.8). Word = 32-bit word index.
The driver loads the table's own address into u0_u1 (agx_usc_uniform(root_unif = 0, 4 halves, root_ptr) with
root_desc_addr first); the preamble loads everything else. Storage-buffer descriptors are hk_buffer_address:
{u64 base, u32 size, u32 zero}, 16 bytes per binding, at sets[0].
